SUMMARY
Situated along the ever-popular Hampshire Street in Portsmouth, this well-presented two-bedroom mid-terraced home offers a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those looking to downsize.

DESCRIPTION
The accommodation comprises a welcoming living room, a separate dining room providing an ideal space for entertaining, and a fitted kitchen with a range of storage and work surfaces. The ground floor also benefits from a cloakroom.

Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned double bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance enclosed rear garden, perfect for outdoor dining and relaxation. Additional benefits include double glazing and gas central heating throughout.

Conveniently located within easy reach of local shops, schools, transport links, and Portsmouth city centre, this charming home combines comfortable living with excellent accessibility.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
